messages.content: I want to revisit the two Minneapolis hotels now that the Tuesday and Friday flights are set. Please put taxes, fees, breakfast, and transportation on the same footing before I decide.

For Tuesday through Friday, the conference hotel is $229 per night plus an $18 nightly facility fee. After the current lodging tax, the three-night total is $852.34. Breakfast is not included; allowing $18 per morning adds $54. Because the conference program is in the building, the only necessary local trip after arrival is Thursday's off-site dinner, about $24 round trip. Practical stay cost: approximately $930.34, excluding airport transfers.

The Warehouse District hotel is $189 per night with no facility fee. With tax, the total is $652.19, and breakfast is included. Four days of rail or rideshare travel to the conference hotel and Thursday dinner should run about $84 to $112. Practical stay cost: $736.19 to $764.19, excluding airport transfers.
So the conference hotel is still roughly $166 more at best. What are the payment terms on each?

Yes. The conference hotel requires a card guarantee but no advance deposit. Payment is collected at checkout. Cancellation is free until 6:00 p.m. Minneapolis time on Sunday, April 11; after that, the penalty is one night including tax and the facility fee, approximately $283.

The Warehouse District hotel charges a one-night deposit of $217.40 when reserved. It is refundable if canceled by 6:00 p.m. on April 11. After the deadline, the deposit is retained.
And confirm the facility fee at the conference hotel is mandatory. I don't want it appearing again on top of your total.

Confirmed. The $18 nightly facility fee is mandatory, taxable, and already included in the $852.34 total. It will not be added a second time. The quoted total covers the room, lodging tax, and all mandatory hotel fees for three nights.
Breakfast is less important than the Friday logistics. My return is at 5:10, and I need to stay through the end of the conference. What will each hotel do with the suitcase after checkout?

The conference hotel will hold a registered guest's luggage after Friday checkout at the bell desk without charge. The desk is staffed through the evening, and they confirmed retrieval at about 2:00 p.m. is acceptable. You can check out before the morning program, leave the bag downstairs, finish the conference, collect it, and depart directly for the airport.

The Warehouse District hotel also offers complimentary same-day storage, but you would need to return there after the conference. That adds roughly 25 to 40 minutes before starting the airport trip, depending on traffic and whether you walk or use a car.
Does either place charge for early departure or require a Friday pickup deadline?

Neither has an early-departure fee if the reservation remains Tuesday through Friday as booked. The conference hotel's bell desk asks that stored bags be collected by 10:00 p.m. Friday. The Warehouse District hotel requires pickup by 8:00 p.m. Neither deadline is a problem for the 5:10 p.m. flight, but the conference property gives you the cleaner route.
Lay out Friday with the conference hotel. The last session ends at noon.

Check out by 8:30 a.m. and leave the suitcase with the bell desk before the first session. Attend the program through noon, then allow 15 minutes to say goodbye and retrieve the bag. Leaving the hotel around 12:20 p.m. should put you at the airport around 12:50 to 1:10 by rideshare or roughly 1:20 by rail, leaving ample time for the 5:10 p.m. departure.
That margin is worth the extra cost, especially with everything except Thursday dinner in the building. Reserve the conference hotel, but keep the flights as already confirmed.

Before I place it: three nights at the conference hotel, arriving Tuesday, April 13 and checking out Friday, April 16, one king room for one guest. Guaranteed total is $852.34, with no deposit, and free cancellation ends at 6:00 p.m. local time April 11. Shall I complete that reservation?

Reserved. Conference hotel confirmation: MSP-413-60482. The guaranteed three-night total is $852.34, including taxes and the mandatory facility fee; payment is due at checkout. Cancellation remains free through 6:00 p.m. Minneapolis time on April 11.

Your Tuesday midday nonstop and Friday 5:10 p.m. return remain unchanged. All conference activities are in the hotel except Thursday dinner. On Friday, check out before the morning program, leave the suitcase at the bell desk, finish the noon session, retrieve the bag around 12:15 p.m., and leave for the airport around 12:20. The Warehouse District reservation is not selected.
